user.title: Connect to CL6
user.description: Use the email and password from the MyCarControls app. Staying signed in on your phone is fine.

vehicle.title: Choose the car
vehicle.description: This account has more than one vehicle.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the CL6 password
reauth_confirm.description: CL6 rejected the saved password for {email}. Enter the current password. The email stays the same.

error.invalid_auth: That email or password was rejected.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not reach CL6. Try again in a minute.
error.no_vehicles: No car was found on this account.
error.unknown: CL6 answered in a way this integration did not understand.

abort.already_configured: This car is already set up.

init.title: CL6 options
init.description: A remote start that is already counting down keeps the timer it began with.

data.extend_once: On a cold day, start one more time when the first run ends

data_description.scan_interval: How often to ask CL6 how the car is. Two minutes is the shortest, because this service is unofficial.
data_description.max_run_minutes: After this many minutes, one engine stop is sent.
data_description.extend_once: Sends a second start when the first run ends, then stops after another full run. It does not ask you to confirm again.
data_description.confirm_seconds: How long a start or unlock waits for you to confirm. After this, it is forgotten and nothing is sent.

error.invalid_run: Use a run time from 1 to 30 minutes.
error.invalid_window: Use a confirmation window from 10 to 180 seconds.

arm.name: Arm
arm.description: Arm a remote start or unlock. Nothing is sent to the car until you confirm.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Send the armed start or unlock. The arm expires and works only once.
